decisions.reason: Adjustable quarter pallet remains a relevant variant in the core cardboard display line with no negative signals.
Pegboard back display is a standard offering that complements the core range and should be retained.
Basic quarter pallet is a core product with steady demand and no reason to discontinue.
Eighth pallet fills a size segment in the display portfolio and is still aligned with established capabilities.
Media-specific quarter pallet serves a niche but remains close to core cardboard pallet production, keep for now.
